findings.claim: "Naming parent is D-086 / occupancy v2, not g20 leftover-join.v9."
findings.refutation: occupancy v2 is not a naming parent of DR-G20, and the artifact this clause cites says so in its own bytes. harness.DR-G20.component-operability.v2 $.authorityClaim reads 'This artifact PROPOSES successor occupancy of the already-named identifier harness.DR-G20.component-operability after D-086 / D-184 / D-195 / D-216... Naming already existed (D-086 / naming v6, dual ACCEPT 0/0).' Its registerRowNote repeats 'This is the occupancy remasurement of the already-named G20 harness identifier.' The naming artifact is gate-harness-naming.v6, which carries DR-G20 at $.gates[19].id with harnessId harness.DR-G20.component-operability. The predecessor read 'Naming parent is D-086 / naming v6, not leftover-join.v6.', which was true. The phrase 'Naming parent is D-086 / naming v6' occurs nine times across this repository - in g20-fixture-corpus.v1 through v6, in g19-fixture-corpus.v1 and v2, and in the frozen g19-fixture-corpus.v1 Claude review - and it survived dual ACCEPT 0/0 at g20-fixture-corpus.v5. 'Naming parent is D-086 / occupancy v2' occurs exactly once in the repository: here. The clause is also circular on its own terms. $.parentReview.path is docs/coop/artifacts/harness.DR-G20.component-operability.v2.review-independent.claude2.json, so parentReview IS the review pair of occupancy v2; the sentence therefore makes occupancy v2 the naming parent of the identifier whose occupancy it is being reviewed for. Its own preceding sentence, 'Independent dual ACCEPT 0/0 of the current occupancy of the already-named identifier', asserts the naming was prior and separate. $.basedOn.occupancyV2.role calls occupancy v2 'Current G20 occupancy remasurement', $.basedOn.d086.role assigns the naming to D-086, and $.registerRowNote calls DR-G20 'the already-named gate'. Four clauses in the same file contradict the fifth.
